map.🔍 尿路感染(菌落计数)诊断器: 🔍 Urinary Tract Infection (Colony Count) Diagnostic Tool
map.尿培养菌落计数结合症状与尿常规，辅助判断尿路感染及定位: Urine culture colony count combined with symptoms and urinalysis to help diagnose and localize urinary tract infection
map.尿路感染诊断：菌落计数高（不低于10^5）+ 尿路症状或发热即诊断；伴发热为急性: UTI diagnosis: a high colony count (not below 10^5) plus urinary symptoms or fever establishes the diagnosis; with fever it is acute pyelonephritis, with only LUTS or suprapubic pain it is acute cystitis, and without symptoms it is asymptomatic bacteriuria; a mid-range count plus symptoms plus pyuria is suspicious, and a low count indicates contamination.
map.一、尿培养菌落计数（清洁中段尿）: 1. Urine culture colony count (clean midstream urine)
map.发热(≥38℃)/腰痛/肋脊角叩痛: Fever (>= 38 C) / flank pain / costovertebral angle tenderness
map.菌落计数临床意义: Clinical significance of the colony count
map.结合药敏抗感染治疗: Anti-infective therapy guided by susceptibility testing
map.结合症状复查，必要时再培养: Recheck together with symptoms; repeat culture if necessary
map.规范留尿复查: Repeat with a properly collected specimen
map.注：急性单纯性膀胱炎女性，有典型症状时≥10³ CFU/mL即可诊断；导尿标本≥: Note: in women with acute uncomplicated cystitis and typical symptoms, >= 10^3 CFU/mL is sufficient for diagnosis; for catheterized specimens >= 10^4 CFU/mL is significant.
map.发热、腰痛、肋脊角叩痛提示上尿路感染（肾盂肾炎）；仅有膀胱刺激征+耻骨上压痛多为: Fever, flank pain and costovertebral angle tenderness indicate upper urinary tract infection (pyelonephritis); bladder irritation alone plus suprapubic tenderness usually indicates lower urinary tract infection (cystitis).
map.⚠️ 本工具仅供临床参考，抗生素使用需根据药敏结果，复杂UTI/反复发作需进一步: ⚠️ This tool is for clinical reference only; antibiotic use must follow susceptibility results, and complicated or recurrent UTI requires further investigation.
map.📚 深度解析：尿路感染菌落计数诊断: 📚 Deep dive: diagnosing urinary tract infection by colony count
map.菌落 ≥10⁵ CFU/mL + 白细胞酯酶/亚硝酸盐阳性 + LUTS，诊断: A colony count >= 10^5 CFU/mL plus positive leukocyte esterase or nitrite plus LUTS: UTI is diagnosed and empiric anti-infective therapy is given; Escherichia coli is the most common pathogen.
map.10⁴-10⁵ CFU/mL 为可疑，需结合症状与镜检，无症状携带者可能不需治疗: 10^4-10^5 CFU/mL is suspicious; it must be combined with symptoms and microscopy, and asymptomatic carriers may not need treatment.
map.导管尿标准？: What is the standard for catheter urine?
map.导尿管相关 UTI 常采用 ≥10³ CFU/mL 阈值（因导管污染），有症状即: Catheter-associated UTI commonly uses a >= 10^3 CFU/mL threshold (because of catheter contamination); treat when symptoms are present.
map.清洁中段尿 ≥10⁵ CFU/mL 是经典阈值；有典型下尿路症状的女性 ≥10²: >= 10^5 CFU/mL in clean midstream urine is the classic threshold; in women with typical lower urinary tract symptoms >= 10^2-10^3 CFU/mL can also be diagnostic; catheter-associated infection is easily contaminated, so >= 10^3 CFU/mL is commonly used. In every case the final judgment should combine symptoms, leukocyte esterase and nitrite.
